question: Who among the following was adjudged as the 'Player of the Series' in the Australia versus India T20I series played in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hardik Pandya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hardik Pandya**__

 __
 
• He is an **Indian international cricketer who plays for Baroda** in domestic cricket.
 
• He will captain Gujarat Titans in the Indian Premier League season 15.
 
• He is an all-rounder who bats right-handed and bowls right-arm fast-medium.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**__

 
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is the governing body for cricket in India and is under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, the Government of India. 
 
• It was formed in December 1928.
 
• President: Sourav Ganguly** (As of March 2022).**
 
• Secretary: Jay Shah ** (As of March 2022).**
